text: Si on ɗuurnike on huccitii e ko mi addi kon, haray fawaaki lam si wanaa yottingol e mooɗon. Gomɗii non mi yottinanii on kala Alla Nulimmi kon O yamiri- mi yottingol. Hujja on ñiiɓii e mon, aray nde Joomi am halkata on, O adda yimɓe goo ko lontoo on. On lorrirtaa Alla ngol fennugol ɗuurnoo mon mawni fanɗi; tawde ko O yondiniiɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Pellet, Joomi am ko reenuɗo kala huunde, ko Kanko reenata lam e bone mo fewjanton lam on.
